meta.name: sem
meta.description: Use sem to get entity-level (function/class/method) semantic diffs, impact analysis, blame, and dependency context from any Git repo. Trigger this skill whenever the user asks what changed in a commit or PR, wants to understand the blast radius of a change, needs to know who last modified a function, wants to trace how a function evolved, or needs structured code context for an LLM task. Also use it proactively when reviewing code, planning refactors, or any time line-level git diff output would be noisy or hard to interpret.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 Git 仓库获取函数级语义差异与影响分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码审查或重构时快速理解变更的语义影响
copy.tagline_en: Get entity-level semantic diffs and impact analysis from any Git repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the semantic impact of changes during code review or refactoring

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以分析 Git 仓库中函数、类等代码实体的变更、影响范围、责任人和历史，并生成结构化上下文。
howto.when: 当用户询问某次提交或 PR 中代码实体的变更、修改某函数的影响范围、谁最后修改了某函数、或需要代码上下文时触发。

say.text: 这个提交里哪些函数被修改了？
say.note: Claude 会运行 sem diff 并列出变更的实体。

say.text: 如果修改 validateToken 函数，会影响哪些代码？
say.note: Claude 会运行 sem impact 并显示影响范围。

say.text: 谁最后修改了 src/auth.ts 里的 validateToken？
say.note: Claude 会运行 sem blame 并显示责任人。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze entity-level (function/class/method) changes, impact, blame, and history from any Git repo, and provide structured code context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about entity changes in a commit or PR, wants to understand the blast radius of a change, needs to know who last modified a function, or needs structured code context.

say_en.text: Which functions were modified in this commit?
say_en.note: Claude runs sem diff and lists changed entities.

say_en.text: What would be affected if I change validateToken?
say_en.note: Claude runs sem impact and shows the blast radius.

say_en.text: Who last modified validateToken in src/auth.ts?
say_en.note: Claude runs sem blame and shows the author.
